rules_lawyer.name: The Rules Lawyer
rules_lawyer.desc: Strict: misses never graze. Traps in rooms, but better loot.

chaos.name: Chaos
chaos.desc: Wild Magic surges on every spell. Friendly fire is on.

enter_room: The torches gutter as you step inside.
Dust drifts from the ceiling. You are not alone.
nat20: A natural twenty! The table erupts.
nat1: A natural one. The DM tries not to smile.
boredom: The DM drums their fingers on the table...
This is taking a while. Let's spice it up.
ambush: AMBUSH! Roll for initiative— no, just run!
rival_party: A rival party bursts in, eyeing your loot!
collapsing_floor: The floor groans. Then gives way.
mercy: A potion rolls out from behind a crate. Lucky.
The DM slides a potion across the table.
boss: The air turns to frost. Something ancient wakes.
downed: A hero falls! Roll those death saves.
tpk: Total party kill. The DM closes the screen softly.
campfire: The campfire crackles. Rest a while.
mystery: A door with no handle. A chest with no lock. What could go wrong?
